title: Man Refuses to Give Up During Insane Police Chase, Doesn’t End Well
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 22, 2023, the Wisconsin State Patrol notified dispatch about a vehicle pursuit entering Columbia County. It began 60 miles away in Juneau County due to alleged speeding in a construction zone. During the chase, multiple spike strips were deployed, along with PIT maneuver attempts, which finally brought his vehicle to a halt. The suspect tried to flee on foot but was quickly apprehended. It was later discovered he was wanted for aggravated 1st-degree robbery in Minnesota. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
